description: Get a short-lived Excel XLSX download for an owned Portravo estimate after every takeoff line has been reviewed and the estimate is priced or final. If review is incomplete, the call returns a review_required error with the Portravo review link, where quantities, assembly mappings and pricing are completed. Never exports unreviewed estimates. The Takeoff sheet carries a Line number, the sheet and area, and the region on the sheet for every line (or says no location was recorded). When the plan set can be marked up, markedPlans is a second short-lived link to a PDF of the customer's plans with each located line drawn and numbered like the Takeoff sheet; otherwise markedPlans is null and markedPlansNote says why.
name: export_reviewed_estimate
title: Download a reviewed estimate workbook
